t83ff084b: How much energy does a computer use?
t7993ae70: Computing – Desktop vs Laptop Energy Use
t0e11a771: Compare energy usage of computing devices
t506ff6b2: Computers are an essential part of modern life. They are used for studying, gaming, communication and entertainment. However, different types of computers consume very different amounts of energy.
tf778037a: Understanding these differences helps users make more sustainable choices while balancing performance and energy efficiency.
tb992b4bb: Desktop computers generally use more electricity because they contain larger processors, dedicated graphics cards and external monitors. Laptops are designed to maximise battery life, making them more energy efficient.
ted426f69: A typical desktop computer may consume between 150 and 300 watts during operation, while a laptop may use between 20 and 60 watts.
tac775541: Although desktops often offer greater performance, laptops can provide significant energy savings over time.
t3f6f910b: This represents a substantial reduction in energy use and environmental impact.
